truth_cross_check: Each row has five identical known labels and one held-out -1 matching its frozen cow ID

scope_definitions.all_six_fixed4_diagnostic: Six revised-ID folds, equal cow weights; fixed four labels with absent-class F1=0; diagnostic, not complete four-class validation
scope_definitions.complete_four_class_A_to_D: Four folds with all four truth classes; E/F excluded only from this declared complete-class scope
scope_definitions.all_six_supported_classes: Six folds; per-cow F1 mean over truth-supported classes, retaining all four outputs; E/F class sets differ; descriptive
scope_definitions.mcc: Multiclass MCC retains four output categories; complete-only MCC is null on E/F; supported-class F1 does not alter MCC
scope_definitions.interval_balanced_window: Each window weight is 1/(retained windows in its original interval); each interval total weight=1; not interval classification
scope_definitions.missing_truth_classes: E feeding and F lying recall are null; their fixed-class F1=0 is a convention, not observed recall
scope_definitions.unsupported_predictions: Predictions of absent truth classes remain errors; no output removal or renormalization

limits: User-attested field identity correction; not independently verified six-animal generalization
One computational seed; no population significance, confidence interval, or human-time-saving claim
Checkpoint bytes hash-verified but not executed or re-inferred by this scorer
All formal positive and negative results retained; all original bundle files remain unchanged
